title: Installation.
officialText:
Fire dampers, smoke dampers, combination fire/smoke dampers and ceiling radiation dampers located within air
distribution and smoke control systems shall be installed in accordance with the requirements of this section, and the manufacturer’s
installation instructions and the damper’s listing.
